name: nativ-docs
description: Documentation for Nativ — local AI, native to your Mac.

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run check:docs && next build
scripts.export: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/nativ/docs npm run gen && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/nativ/docs next build
scripts.deploy: npm run export && rm -rf ../website/docs && cp -r out ../website/docs
